resources.string: Check for a newer DeskInk version without visiting the download page.
An update is available. Download it here, then install when you finish presenting. Your PC registrations and settings are kept.
Downloading and verifying the update… You can close this panel and keep writing.
Ready to install. Android will ask you to confirm. DeskInk will close during installation; finish your presentation first.
Could not check or verify the update. DeskInk keeps working. Check your internet connection and try again.
On the next screen, allow this app to install updates, then return to DeskInk. You only need to enable this once. Android still asks before installation.
